title: Latency Orbit Explorer: model/route p50-p95-p99 split with streaming gap diagnostics
creator: Ava Mitchell
description: Goal: Build a diagnostic dashboard (the 'Orbit Explorer') that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency per model and per route, explicitly separating streaming (server-sent events / websocket) and non-streaming (blocking/sync) request paths. The board should make it easy for SREs and runtime engineers to: 1) detect streaming/non-streaming latency gaps, 2) correlate spikes with trace hooks and tail traces, 3) inspect input shapes (prompt length, history size) and kernel-level indicators (batch size, KV cache hits), and 4) pivot to logs and recent deploys.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 per model x route matrix with streaming and non-streaming columns. 2) Each cell links to representative traces (sampled tail + recent failures). 3) Time-range quick filters (1h, 6h, 24h, 7d) and cohort filters (prompt token bins, streaming session length). 4) Alerts defined for p95 regression over baseline and for 99th percentile spikes. 5) All panels use unified telemetry tags so the same queries work across hosted/dedicated/private clusters.
implementation_notes: Telemetry: use existing trace hook tags (trace.source, serve.path, io.mode) and enrich with runtime fields: kernel_variant, batch_effective_size, kv_cache_hit_rate. Metrics pipeline: extend metrics-transform to emit a derived metric latency.quantiles_by_io_mode using histogram->quantile projection at ingestion time to make dashboards performant. Logs: add streaming session ID to request logs for join. Traces: increase tail-sampling to 5% for requests where p99 deviation > 3x baseline in the last 15m. Dashboards: implement in Grafana using Loki for logs and Tempo for traces. Provide a lightweight JSON view for Console integration.
queries_examples:
- p95 streaming for model 'redwood-alpha' on /v1/chat: sum(rate(latency_bucket{model="redwood-alpha",io_mode="stream"}[5m])) by (le) -> compute quantile(0.95)
- cohort filter for prompt_length 0-512 tokens: label_replace(metric, "prompt_bin", "0-512", "prompt_length", "^([0-9]+)$")
- sample trace link: /console/traces?service=inference&trace.selector=tags.serve.path=/v1/chat&tags.io.mode=stream&min_duration_ms=1000
